- get_amazon_search_results: Amazon Data Scraper is the easiest way to get access to product,price,sales rank and reviews data from Amazon in JSON format. Get Amazon Search Results
- get_amazon_product_reviews: Amazon Data Scraper API is a great solution for getting access to all the products, price, reviews, ratings, sales rank and many more from Amazon in JSON format.. Here you will get the all the product
- analyze_webpage_sentiment: Analyze text for sentiment and broader concepts.. Analyze the overall sentiment of a webpage. Supported languages: Arabic, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish.
- create_database: THIS ENDPOINT IS USED TO STORE YOUR DATA INSIDE THE OPEN DATABSE { YOU HAVE TO SET CUSTOM NAME FOR YOUR DATABasE }
